package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for tx_begin_per_item_loop: Transactions started inside loops instead of once around the wider batch.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Item struct {
	ID     int
	Status string
}

func ProcessItems(db *gorm.DB, items []Item) error {
	for _, item := range items {
		tx := db.Begin()
		if tx.Error != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("begin tx: %w", tx.Error)
		}
		if err := tx.Model(&Item{}).Where("id = ?", item.ID).Update("status", item.Status).Error; err != nil {
			tx.Rollback()
			return fmt.Errorf("update item %d: %w", item.ID, err)
		}
		if err := tx.Commit().Error; err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("commit item %d: %w", item.ID, err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func ArchiveDocuments(db *gorm.DB, ids []int) error {
	for _, id := range ids {
		tx := db.Begin()
		defer tx.Rollback()
		if err := tx.Exec("UPDATE documents SET archived = true WHERE id = ?", id).Error; err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := tx.Commit().Error; err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
